siteArea.boundaryStatus: Parent GIS context only; Lot 1 is not registered to aerial imagery or independently reconciled.

defaultRecommendation: Use archived public elevation and imagery plus local Three.js terrain. No paid GIS account, Google key, Cesium token or billing is required for initial parcel terrain acquisition and visualization. Keep source horizontal/vertical CRS and acquisition metadata. Add cloud services only if a later feature needs them.

sources.title: APA GIS Downloads
sources.role: Adirondack wetland covertypes, official promulgated wetlands, park land classification, rivers and watershed context
sources.access: Public downloads and REST; no token used for downloaded AOI layers
sources.limits: APA says maps are not legal jurisdictional determinations; airphoto wetland classification dates 1994-1999 and may omit wetlands. Use site permit delineation flags as separately sourced evidence.
sources.status: AOI wetland areas, wetland lines, land classification acquired with raw layer metadata and query URLs

sources.title: USFWS NWI services
sources.role: National wetland polygons and dataset provenance context
sources.access: Public REST/WMS; no API key used
sources.limits: Remote mapping; no negative intersection establishes no wetlands, present-day delineation, or permit clearance.

sources.title: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer
sources.role: Flood zones, effective panel dates, NFHL availability and coverage
sources.access: Public ArcGIS REST; no API key used
sources.limits: Availability polygons are not flood zones; distinguish unmapped/unavailable from outside mapped flood hazard. AOI flood-zone geometry request failed HTTP500; do not interpret failure as no flood hazard.
sources.status: 2 availability polygons downloaded; full flood-zone geometry request failed, attributes-only query succeeded with 1 intersecting zone X / AREA OF MINIMAL FLOOD HAZARD, study36019C. See fema-flood-zones-attributes.json. Not a Lot1 determination.

sources.title: USGS 3DHP products
sources.role: Mapped flowlines and waterbodies; compare with elevation-derived drainage
sources.access: Public REST/downloads; no API key used
sources.limits: Product coverage/vintage and workunit metadata vary. Stream lines are contextual, not surveyed ditch, culvert, flood level or drainage engineering. Legacy NHD/WBD no longer maintained since transition in 2024.
sources.status: 2 flowlines and 1 waterbody downloaded for AOI

sources.title: NRCS Soil Data Access
sources.role: SSURGO map units, components, horizons, drainage class, hydric rating, saturated conductivity, depth to restrictive layer, seasonal water-table estimates
sources.access: Documented public SQL REST POST, WFS and WMS; no credential shown in official request format
sources.limits: Map-unit composition and representative ranges; not site borings, septic suitability, bearing capacity, or exact depth-to-rock. Retain component percentage and horizon depths rather than one misleading soil value.
sources.status: Documentation verified; AOI soils not yet downloaded

sources.title: NYS Museum GIS geology
sources.role: Adirondack regional surficial/bedrock and fault context; check newer quadrangle mapping
sources.limits: Statewide Adirondack sheets are 1:250000 regional mapping, unsuitable for parcel excavation depth or foundation decisions. Seek site-specific geotechnical evidence.
sources.status: Documentation verified; no geology download yet

sources.title: NYS DEC Environmental Resources Mapper
sources.role: Protected stream classifications, natural communities, rare-species generalized screening, other environmental context
sources.access: Public map and state GIS downloads
sources.limits: ERM explicitly excludes Adirondack Park freshwater wetlands and directs users to APA. Current DEC wetland rules were affected by an April 2026 court decision; avoid applying a simplified statewide rule to this APA site.
sources.status: Primary guidance verified; parcel constraints not yet queried

sources.title: Climate.OneBuilding weather repository
sources.role: Candidate EPW/STAT/DDY/WEA weather files for Ladybug; compare Plattsburgh and upland stations for terrain/elevation mismatch
sources.access: Public weather-file downloads; no GIS account required
sources.limits: Typical year is assembled climate, not parcel observations, future climate, extreme weather proof, or forest/lake microclimate. Compare station elevation/distance and choose explicit period.
sources.status: 2 candidate New York TMYx2011-2025 ZIPs downloaded; no file selected or climate analysis run.

sources.title: Ladybug weather import
sources.role: Parse EPW location and hourly weather for environmental design summaries
sources.access: Open-source software and local files; no service API key required
sources.limits: Terrain shadows need geometry, actual site coordinates, north and seasonal canopy assumptions; nearest EPW coordinate does not become parcel coordinate.

sources.title: NASA POWER daily API
sources.role: Solar/met cross-check or gridded climate gaps
sources.access: Public documented HTTP GET; no token in example requests
sources.limits: Coarse source grid, not parcel measured wind, tree shade or topographic microclimate. Respect request limits; avoid duplicate-cell downloads.
sources.status: Documentation verified; no parcel weather request made

sources.title: NOAA NCEI Access Data Service
sources.role: Historical station weather, precipitation and extremes cross-check
sources.access: Public Access Data Service GET format has no token; CDO v2 is separate and requires token
sources.limits: Station coverage/quality flags vary; not EPW selection by itself. No station validation yet.

sources.title: CesiumJS quickstart
sources.role: Optional globe/region-scale 3D viewer, streamed terrain and buildings
sources.access: CesiumJS engine open source; ion-hosted assets require account/token and plan-dependent service quotas
sources.limits: Global terrain and photogrammetric scene are visual context unless accuracy/datum/vintage is independently established. For local parcel mesh keep primary geospatial data independent of viewer.
sources.status: Documentation verified; no account created, token requested or plan enabled

sources.title: Google Elevation API usage/billing
sources.role: Optional on-demand point/profile elevation in Google experience
sources.access: Requires enabled billing and API key/OAuth
sources.limits: Poor default for reproducible archived parcel terrain. Policies restrict storing/caching and elevation results shown on a map must be on a Google map. Do not build a self-hosted terrain archive from this API.
sources.status: Documentation verified; no API enabled or billed

sources.title: Google Elevation API policies
sources.role: Check permitted display/storage before any Google elevation integration
sources.limits: No API call or account required to read policies.
